note: XXIII fill shots, recipe B, the sky of 3-4 Oct 1893
style: An oil painting of 1893, painted alla prima in the manner of Sargent, Atkinson Grimshaw and the Victorian narrative painters: visible loose brushstrokes, thick impasto in the lights, thin transparent glazes in the shadows, soft lost edges, broken colour, canvas weave showing through; pale, cool early-October daylight in England: a low autumn sun a third of the way up the sky, soft silvery light through thin high cloud, long cool shadows, colours muted and slightly grey-green, trees only beginning to turn; no golden glow. Horse-drawn traffic only, no motor cars. Figures small, unidealised. Not an illustration, not digital art. One single painting filling the whole 16:9 frame, no text, lettering, signature, border or black bars.

beats.text: Shot: very wide. Piccadilly on a pale October afternoon, 1893: grand stone houses, hansom cabs and a horse-drawn omnibus, gentlemen in top hats, the trees of Green Park on the other side, cool silvery light.

Shot: far, exterior, looking in. Through the tall front window of a Piccadilly mansion on a grey afternoon: in the dim hall a tall dark figure in a long coat and hat, seen small from behind, stops in the doorway; a cab passing outside.
